title: claude skills list cannot see a skill directory canon has forgotten, so an orphan is invisible to the only instrument that looks
body:
**MEASURED 2026-08-30 by ic, driven under a fixture `$HOME` so the operator's real `~/.claude` was never written to.**

```
intent claude skills install   in-verify          ->  "installed (1 file(s))"   SKILL.md present
intent claude skills uninstall in-verify --force  ->  "removed (1 file(s))"     rc=0
after:  ~/.claude/skills/in-verify/  SURVIVES, 0 entries, no SKILL.md
```

**`uninstall` unlinks a skill's CONTENTS and leaves its DIRECTORY.** The husk is not loadable -- `SKILL.md` is gone -- so this is not a correctness hazard for the agent. It is a reporting one, and that is the half worth a number.

**`intent claude skills list` CANNOT SEE IT, BY CONSTRUCTION RATHER THAN BY OVERSIGHT.** The listing enumerates the CANON ROSTER and reports each row's install state. A directory that canon has forgotten is not a row, so it is not examined, so it is not reported. Measured: canon 23, `~/.claude/skills/` 25, `list` reports 23 and every one `installed canon`. **The two orphans are invisible to the only instrument that looks at that directory.**

Live instances, both dated 2026-08-29 12:55: `~/.claude/skills/in-start` and `~/.claude/skills/in-next`, 0 entries each, stranded by the `in-start` / `in-next` retirement.

**THIS OUTLIVES A FIX TO THE UNINSTALLER, WHICH IS WHY IT IS NOT `0078`.** `0078` is about `uninstall --force` leaving something behind; this is about the reporter being structurally unable to see anything the roster does not name, WHATEVER stranded it -- a hand-copied skill, an interrupted install, a rename. Fixing `uninstall` to `rmdir` closes one source and leaves the blindness exactly where it is.

**The correct order of operations did not survive a verb that does not reach as far as the plan assumed.** The retirement sequenced uninstall BEFORE the canon delete precisely so that no intermediate state could strand a skill; because uninstall does not remove the directory, two were stranded anyway, and then the canon delete removed the only rows that would have named them.

**Remedy shape, not prescribed:** the listing needs a second arm that reads the DIRECTORY and reports what canon does not name -- the population it can enumerate is not the population it is asked about. The `0115` shape.

**Nothing in `~/.claude/` was removed in the course of measuring this.** It is outside the repo and the last two writes there each needed hv's explicit authorisation; the repro above ran entirely under a temporary `$HOME`.

Related: `0078` (uninstall leaves the directory). Its title also says the stranded skill is "fully loadable", and that clause is FALSE against this build -- `SKILL.md` is unlinked. `intent issues` has `add`, `show`, `close` and `open` and NO verb that sets a body on an existing issue, so `0078` cannot be corrected in place; that correction is recorded on ic's board and with vc rather than hand-edited into canon, which this project has measured to be reverted by the next store-to-canon write.
